members.name: Larry Hack
members.desc: I'm a technology executive with 30+ years of experience as CIO, CTO, and SVP across retail, ecommerce, financial services, mortgage, and logistics. Most recently I led a 172-person IT organization across 14 countries at PriceSmart. Before that, I led technology through two exits: The Home Depot's $195M acquisition of Blinds.com and the 2023 sale of CPAP.com. I grew up in a family business that sold furniture refinishing products, made the top 10 infomercials in 1991, and went online in 1998, so I learned early that technology has to serve the business. I'm a PMP, Agile Certified Practitioner, and Certified Scrum Professional. My approach: keep learning, test ideas in small steps, scale what works, teach what I learn, and be a good person to work with.

members.name: Peter Phillip
members.desc: Peter has spent 25+ years as a trusted advisor in technology, strategy, and business improvement, guided by a servant leadership philosophy. He has served nearly 150 clients, from startups to Fortune 10 companies, across the energy, healthcare, manufacturing, finance, and consumer industries, and he consults with many large clients on security. He advises and mentors leadership teams on using technology better and helps companies improve the bottom line by implementing both emerging and established technologies.

members.name: Slav Petkovic
members.desc: Slav is a data scientist and AI developer who blends data science, artificial intelligence, and business intelligence into practical solutions. His skills span data engineering, data mining, and predictive modeling, and he builds data-centric applications that deliver strategic business insight. He brings the scientific method, thorough research, and strong organizational discipline to analyzing and refining complex processes.

members.name: AI-Assisted Delivery
members.desc: We use AI throughout our engineering, analysis, and documentation work, so clients get faster prototypes, broader test coverage, and quicker answers. Our senior leaders set the standards for quality, security, and governance, and AI speeds up how we meet them.
